open_points.subject: data_provider dependency
open_points.text:
“modules on one line do not know each other” contradicts “### Knows

`models`: the row models of its tables and the enumerations their cells name.” because `models` and `data_provider` remain on the same dependency line.
open_points.question: May `data_provider` depend on `models`, and if so how must the dependency layering change?
options: Put `data_provider` on a later dependency line than `models`
Remove the dependency and represent the tables without `models` types
open_points.default_guess: Put `data_provider` on its own line immediately after `models`.

open_points.subject: EXECUTION_STATUS_CONCLUSIONS
open_points.text: “the conclusion each NodeExecution status gives (A13 rules 5 and 7)” is declared as “a table here keyed by the enumeration, total over its members”, but an `outcome_unknown` NodeExecution concludes differently according to its EffectAttempt: waiting while `unknown`, succeeded when resolved `applied` without outputs, failed when resolved `applied` with outputs, and ready for another attempt when resolved `not_applied`.
open_points.question: What value does the status-only table assign to `outcome_unknown`, and where is the EffectAttempt-dependent override represented?
options: Map it to an unresolved wait and let `effects.operation_element_conclusion` override it
Give the table a context-dependent or sentinel result
Key this correspondence by both execution status and effect-attempt state
open_points.default_guess: Map `outcome_unknown` to an unresolved wait and have `effects.operation_element_conclusion` supply every resolved conclusion.

open_points.subject: NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS
open_points.text: “what each node conclusion means for the run and for its dependants … is a correspondence over that taxonomy … whose cells name members”, but no closed `node conclusion` or `node conclusion effect` enumeration is named in the models.
open_points.question: Which enumeration supplies the rows of `NODE_CONCLUSION_EFFECTS`, which enumerations supply its cells, and what are their members?
options: Add explicit node-conclusion and consequence enumerations to `models`
Use existing NodeExecution-status and Run-status members with a specified composite row
Define the table as non-enumerated structured policy data
open_points.default_guess: Add explicit node-conclusion and consequence enumerations and define a total mapping from them.

open_points.subject: HTTP_METHOD_BODIES
open_points.text: “whether an HTTP method carries a body … is a correspondence over that taxonomy … whose cells name members”, but the texts name HTTP-method members only and name no enumeration whose members mean body or no body.
open_points.question: Are `HTTP_METHOD_BODIES` cells booleans, members of a new body-disposition enumeration, or HTTP-method members grouped by body behavior?
options: Two sets of HTTP-method enumeration members
open_points.default_guess: Use a boolean total mapping: `GET` and `DELETE` false; `POST`, `PUT` and `PATCH` true.
